summary: Kerb of a central traffic island at a junction; nowhere to pull out.
reasons: No room beside the traffic lane

drivers.seclusion: Shaded junction with homes about 24 to 27 m away and a kindergarten 23 m off.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a tree-covered island between carriageways; a van would block the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road on Boomerang Road with a junction on both sides.
drivers.convention: No signs; cars park only on the wider road to the south-west.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the island, mostly shade all day.
